The [first DSIR post](../dsir-intro/index.qmd) introduced a shared format for
WHO GHO and UN SDG data. [DSIR 0.10.0](https://github.com/shanlong-who/DSIR/blob/main/NEWS.md)
adds ways to inspect and keep the detail behind each observation: population
breakdowns, units, sources, and notes. Both cleaners still return the same
15 columns by default.

These examples require **DSIR 0.10.0 or later** and `dplyr`. See the
[public repository](https://github.com/shanlong-who/DSIR#installation) for
installation instructions. The first two examples call the live UN SDG API;
the displayed results were retrieved on 4 October 2026.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DSIR))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(dplyr))

stopifnot(packageVersion("DSIR") >= "0.10.0")
```
:::


## 1. Look up official dimension codes

[`sdg_dimensions()`](https://github.com/shanlong-who/DSIR/blob/main/man/sdg_dimensions.Rd)
reads series-specific code lists without downloading observations.
`include_attributes = TRUE` also includes attributes such as units and data
nature. Here we inspect age and sex codes for the SDG 3.8.2 series used below.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
codebook <- suppressMessages(sdg_dimensions(
  "3.8.2", series = "SH_OOP_XPD_EARNNET40",
  include_attributes = TRUE
))
stopifnot(nrow(codebook) > 0L)

codebook %>%
  filter(kind == "dimension", dimension %in% c("Age", "Sex")) %>%
  select(dimension, code, label, sdmx) %>%
  head(8L)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 6 × 4
  dimension code    label                              sdmx  
  <chr>     <chr>   <chr>                              <chr> 
1 Age       0-59    under 59 years old                 Y0T59 
2 Age       60+     60 years old and over              Y_GE60
3 Age       ALLAGE  All age ranges or no breaks by age _T    
4 Sex       BOTHSEX Both sexes                         _T    
5 Sex       FEMALE  Female                             F     
6 Sex       MALE    Male                               M     
```


:::
:::


Use `code` in filters: the alternative `sdmx` representation can differ.
A category in the codebook does not guarantee observations for every country.

## 2. Select a stratum and retain its context

This follows the [documented national-total example](https://github.com/shanlong-who/DSIR#un-sdg-api)
for the Philippines. Dimension names and codes are exact and case-sensitive.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
national.raw <- suppressMessages(sdg_data(
  "3.8.2", area = "PHL",
  series = "SH_OOP_XPD_EARNNET40",
  dimensions = list(
    Age = "ALLAGE", Location = "ALLAREA", Sex = "BOTHSEX",
    Quantile = "_T", Type_of_household = "_T"
  )
))
stopifnot(nrow(national.raw) > 0L)

national <- sdg_clean(
  national.raw, keep_dimensions = TRUE, keep_metadata = TRUE
)

national %>%
  select(iso3, year, value_num, dim_sex, attr_units, attr_nature) %>%
  tail(5L)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 5 × 6
  iso3   year value_num dim_sex attr_units attr_nature
  <chr> <int>     <dbl> <chr>   <chr>      <chr>      
1 PHL    2012      36.8 BOTHSEX PERCENT    G          
2 PHL    2015      35.2 BOTHSEX PERCENT    G          
3 PHL    2018      31.6 BOTHSEX PERCENT    C          
4 PHL    2021      33.8 BOTHSEX PERCENT    C          
5 PHL    2023      31.0 BOTHSEX PERCENT    C          
```


:::
:::


`keep_dimensions = TRUE` appends named SDG columns such as `dim_age` and
`dim_sex`; `dim1` through `dim3` remain GHO-only positions.
`keep_metadata = TRUE` retains observation attributes, source and time
context, and all footnotes and linked codes. Notes and linked codes are
list-columns. See [`sdg_clean()`](https://github.com/shanlong-who/DSIR/blob/main/man/sdg_clean.Rd).

**The filters run locally after all pages are downloaded.** They do not reduce
the number of pages fetched. DSIR checks declared page numbers, page counts,
and total row counts before filtering. An inconsistent or incomplete download
warns and returns no rows; counts omitted by the API cannot be verified.
A requested dimension absent from the response also warns and returns no rows.
[`sdg_coverage()`](https://github.com/shanlong-who/DSIR/blob/main/man/sdg_coverage.Rd)
accepts the same filters and now retains download warnings.

## 3. Save the result for reuse

[`snapshot()`](https://github.com/shanlong-who/DSIR/blob/main/man/snapshot.Rd),
added in 0.9.0, saves an expression's result as an RDS file. RDS preserves the
list-columns above. The second call proves that an existing snapshot is read
without evaluating the expression again.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
snapshot.path <- file.path(tempdir(), "sdg-3-8-2-phl-national.rds")
saved <- suppressMessages(snapshot(national, file = snapshot.path))
reused <- suppressMessages(snapshot(
  stop("This expression should not run."), file = snapshot.path
))
identical(saved, reused)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] TRUE
```


:::
:::


For reuse across R sessions, choose a fixed path in your project instead of
`tempdir()`. `refresh = TRUE` re-evaluates the expression; put an API pull inside
that expression when a refresh should download data again. An empty refresh
is never written over a good snapshot; the older result is returned with a warning.

## Other changes worth knowing

For GHO, [`gho_clean()`](https://github.com/shanlong-who/DSIR/blob/main/man/gho_clean.Rd)
can now retain each row's dimension types (`dim1_type` through `dim3_type`),
identifiers, source codes, time context, update timestamps, and comments.
Types are copied from source fields rather than inferred from codes.
`bind_indicators()` now preserves extra columns and fills missing fields
when inputs have different dimensions.

Version 0.9.0 also added
[`age_standardize()`](https://github.com/shanlong-who/DSIR/blob/main/man/age_standardize.Rd)
for direct age standardization with optional Fay-Feuer gamma confidence
intervals, and [`life_table()`](https://github.com/shanlong-who/DSIR/blob/main/man/life_table.Rd)
for period life tables from age-specific mortality rates. The
[release notes](https://github.com/shanlong-who/DSIR/blob/main/NEWS.md) describe
the full changes.
